newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Grp sells more shares in unit.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Grp sells more shares in unit.

text.p: Malaysia's Berjaya Group Bhd said on Monday it had sold a further 19 percent stake in its property and investment arm Berjaya Industrial Bhd.
In a statement, Berjaya Group said it had sold the remaining eight percent stake that it directly owns, and a further 11 percent stake held by a wholly-owned subsidiary.

The sale comprised 96.37 million shares priced at 3.50 ringgit per share, amounting to 337.29 million ringgit. The shares were sold by means of a placement to stockbroking houses, Berjaya said in its statement.
Berjaya Group also said it would make an extraordinary gain of 79 million ringgit at group level from the sale of the 19 percent stake.
On December 3 Berjaya Group announced it would divest a 32 percent stake in Berjaya Industrial for 568.06 million ringgit in cash.

In its statement on Monday Berjaya Group said the divestment of a total of 51 percent equity interest in Berjaya Industrial will result in an extraordinary gain of 207.4 million ringgit at group level.
Berjaya Group said the placement is in line with its objective to realise its investment in Berjaya Industrial at an attractive price and to realise the potential capital gain in full.
Berjaya Industrial shares closed down seven cents to 2.04 ringgit, while Berjaya Group shares were up four cents to 1.82 ringgit.
